cost.source: NO cost/margin/cogs column in order_items/orders/products/order_payments; order_payments only payment_type/installments/value

promotions.note: no promo/discount/campaign/coupon fields in any table

weekly_price_variation_check.interpretation: price mostly flat per product over time; per-product elasticity identifiable only for a minority; category pooling + Unsupported marking required; single-equation log-log is descriptive, not causal (no experimental/instrumental variation exists)

avg_price_fill.note: price observed only in sale weeks

demand_granularity_and_separation.architecture_separation: Part-3 Production forecast = demand baseline at current price; elasticity = price demand-response on top; forecasting model unmodified

test_period.usage: NOT used for tuning or repeated inspection

profit_executability.blocked_by: Cost absent in all repository data
profit_executability.engine_without_cost: simulation grid + demand-response + revenue fully executed; profit columns and profit-optimal price computed as PROFIT_NOT_COMPUTABLE; revenue-optimal scenario + guardrail bounds reported
profit_executability.engine_with_cost: optional external cost input (product_id -> cost) activates profit optimizer + margin guardrails for supplied products
